title: Honey Gloss Ceramide Therapy Hydrating Shampoo & Conditioner Duo
descriptionHtml:
✓ Ceramide✓ All Hair Types✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Increases Shine✓ Without Silicones

What it is: An intensely hydrating full-size shampoo and conditioner powered by fermented Mirsalehi honey and biomimetic ceramides for stronger, glossier hair every wash.


Hair Texture: Straight, Wavy, Curly, and Coily


Hair Type: Fine, Medium, and Thick


Hair Concerns:
- Damage, Split Ends, and Breakage

- Shine

- Dryness


Key Benefits:
- Detangles

- Hydrates

- Polishes


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Fermented Mirsalehi Honey: Promotes healthy scalp microbiome.

- Bee Garden Oil Blend: Nourishes and provides long-lasting shine.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Cleanse with the Honey Gloss Ceramide Therapy Hydrating Shampoo.
-Emulsify to create a luxurious lather.
-Massage into wet scalp and hair, then rinse.
-Polish with the Honey Gloss Ceramide Therapy Hydrating Conditioner.
-Squeeze out excess water and distribute evenly from mid-length to ends.
-Leave for one to two minutes, then rinse.
Ingredients+

-Fermented Mirsalehi Honey: Promotes healthy scalp microbiome.

-Bee Garden Oil Blend: Nourishes and provides long-lasting shine.

-Biomimetic Ceramides: Repair damage and strengthen hair.


Honey Gloss Ceramide Therapy Hydrating Shampoo:
Aqua (Water/Eau), Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate, Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Coco-Glucoside, Sodium Cocoyl Glutamate, Parfum (Fragrance), PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Sodium Chloride, Mel (Honey/Miel)*, Ceramide NP, Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate, Tocopherol, Propolis Cera (Propolis Wax /Cire de Propolis)*, Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Seed Oil, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Carthamus Tinctorius (Safflower) Seed Oil, Calendula Officinalis Flower Extract, Oenothera Biennis (Evening Primrose) Oil, Citrus Aurantium Dulcis (Orange) Fruit Extract, Citrus Limon (Lemon) Fruit Extract, Rosa Canina Fruit Oil, Vaccinium Myrtillus Fruit Extract, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia (Bergamot) Fruit Extract, Daucus Carota Sativa (Carrot) Root Extract, Bisabolol, Saccharomyces Ferment Lysate Filtrate, Glycerin, Ethylhexylglycerin, Glyceryl Oleate, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride, Polyquaternium-10, 1,2-Hexanediol, Saccharum Officinarum (Sugarcane) Extract, Acer Saccharum (Sugar Maple) Extract, Caramel, Glycol Distearate, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Propylene Glycol, Citric Acid, Sorbic Acid, Sodium Hydroxide, Salicylic Acid, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate, Benzyl Alcohol, Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil**, Coumarin**, Hexyl Cinnamal**, Limonene**, Linalool**, Linalyl Acetate**, Orange 4 (Cl 15510).


Honey Gloss Ceramide Therapy Hydrating Conditioner:
Aqua (Water/Eau), Cetearyl Alcohol, Glycerin, Parfum (Fragrance), Behentrimonium Chloride, Cetrimonium Chloride, Mel (Honey/Miel)*, Ceramide NP, Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate, Tocopherol, Tocopheryl Acetate, Propolis Cera (Propolis Wax /Cire de Propolis)*, Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Seed Oil, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Carthamus Tinctorius (Safflower) Seed Oil, Calendula Officinalis Flower Extract, Oenothera Biennis (Evening Primrose) Oil, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia (Bergamot) Fruit Extract, Rosa Canina Fruit Oil, Daucus Carota Sativa (Carrot) Root Extract, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Gardenia Taitensis Flower Extract, Panthenol, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Saccharomyces Ferment Lysate Filtrate, Silk Amino Acids, Ethylhexylglycerin, Polyquaternium-37, Stearamidopropyl Dimethylamine, Propylene Glycol Dicaprylate/Dicaprate, Lactic Acid, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Creatine, Isopropyl Alcohol, PPG-1 Trideceth-6, Citric Acid, Potassium Sorbate, Mica, Sodium Benzoate, 1,2-Hexanediol, Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil**, Coumarin**, Hexyl Cinnamal**, Limonene**, Linalool**, Linalyl Acetate**, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77491).


*Honey and propolis sourced from the Mirsalehi Bee Garden.

**Allergens.


The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.


Product Disclosures:

For external use only. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of children.
